hooks.name: aidlc-enforce-approval-gate
hooks.description: Stops the assistant from acting while the workflow is waiting for your approval, until you have actually replied.

action.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\aidlc\aidlc-shim.ps1" engine adapter kiro-ide enforce-approval-gate
